purpose: Bind the current superconductivity benchmark working copies to external formula and dataset provenance records.

derived_inputs.preprocessing: Generated from the in-script SUPERCONDUCTOR_DATA working-copy table; not a raw upstream table.
derived_inputs.unit_system: Tc_K and Theta_D_K in Kelvin; lambda_ep and mu_star dimensionless.

derived_inputs.preprocessing: Topic-local Allen-Dynes/UET candidate package with material descriptors; not yet row-normalized to upstream records.
derived_inputs.unit_system: Tc_exp_K and omega_log_K in Kelvin-equivalent units; couplings dimensionless.

derived_inputs.preprocessing: Inverse-McMillan calibration table generated from target Tc values.
derived_inputs.unit_system: Tc_K and Theta_D_K in Kelvin; lambda_calibrated and mu_star dimensionless.
derived_inputs.benchmark_role: calibration diagnostic only; cannot support no-fit prediction claims

claim_boundary: This source-lock package improves provenance, but the current raw McMillan verifier still records a model-gate failure and does not promote UET superconductivity claims.
